summary: Rise Gold Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that the Superior Court of California denied its Writ of Mandamus seeking recognition of a vested right to operate the Idaho-Maryland Mine. The court acknowledged a constitutional right vested in 1954 but ruled the right was abandoned by 1963. Rise plans to appeal the ruling, which relates to litigation rather than a corporate transaction. No deal terms, stakeholders, or transaction mechanics are present. This is a litigation update, not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, or structural corporate event.
